svg.text: BC/DR and Incident Response Compliance | AWS Architecture
Target design, not yet deployed. Purple lines follow a quarterly DR test from restore to recorded evidence and findings.
Each quarter Scheduler starts the Step Functions DR test run.
The test restores a Backup recovery point into an isolated test target, never the live resource.
The restored copy of the protected tables or data goes to the restore validator.
The validator checks row counts and checksums, times the restore, and records RTO and RPO.
Achieved RTO and RPO are compared with targets; the test report is written to S3.
A failed or late test raises a finding through EventBridge.
The finding becomes an entry in the risk register (07) for the owner to treat.
The test results and report are added to the evidence lake (06) as BC/DR evidence.
The IR lead runs Systems Manager Automation runbooks and files tabletop exercise records in S3.
CloudWatch alarms on failed or overdue DR tests; the restored copy is deleted after the check.
